1001.name: March 7th
1001.description:
A girl who once slumbered in eternal ice and knows nothing about her past.
To find out the truth about her origins, she decided to travel with the Astral Express.
As of right now, she has prepared about **67** different versions of her life story for herself.

skills.name: Frigid Cold Arrow
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of March 7th's ATK to one enemy.

skills.name: The Power of Cuteness
skills.description:
Provides a single ally with a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of March 7th's DEF plus ****4[i]**** for **2[i]** turn(s).
If the ally's current HP percentage is **3[i]%** or higher, greatly increases the chance of enemies attacking that ally.

skills.name: Glacial Cascade
skills.description:
Deals Ice DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of March 7th's ATK to all enemies. Hit enemies have a **2[i]%** **base chance** to be Frozen for **3[i]** turn(s).
While Frozen, enemies cannot take action and will receive Ice **Additional DMG** equal to ****4[i]%**** of March 7th's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

skills.name: Girl Power
skills.description: After a Shielded ally is attacked by an enemy, March 7th immediately **Counters**, dealing Ice DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of her ATK. This effect can be triggered **2[i]** time(s) each turn.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Freezing Beauty
skills.description:
Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, there is a **1[i]%** **base chance** to Freeze a random enemy for **2[i]** turn(s).
While Frozen, the enemy cannot take action and will take Ice **Additional DMG** equal to **3[i]%** of March 7th's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

ranks.name: Memory of You
ranks.description: Every time March 7th's Ultimate Freezes a target, she regenerates **1[i]** Energy.

ranks.name: Memory of It
ranks.description: Upon entering battle, grants a Shield equal to **1[i]%** of March 7th's DEF plus **3[i]** to the ally with the lowest HP percentage, lasting for **2[i]** turn(s).

ranks.name: Memory of Everything
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Never Forfeit Again
ranks.description: The Talent's **Counter** effect can be triggered 1 more time in each turn. The DMG dealt by **Counter** increases by an amount that is equal to **1[i]%** of March 7th's DEF.

ranks.name: Never Forget Again
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: Just Like This, Always...
ranks.description: Allies under the protection of the Shield granted by the Skill restore HP equal to **1[i]%** of their Max HP plus **2[i]** at the beginning of each turn.

1002.name: Dan Heng
1002.description:
A cold and reserved young man who is reticent about his past.
To avoid his kin, he decided to travel with the Astral Express.

skills.name: Cloudlancer Art: North Wind
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Dan Heng's ATK to one enemy.

skills.name: Cloudlancer Art: Torrent
skills.description:
Deals Wind DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Dan Heng's ATK to one designated enemy.
When DMG dealt by Skill triggers CRIT Hit, there is a **4[i]%** **base chance** to reduce the target's SPD by **2[i]%**, lasting for **3[i]** turn(s).

skills.name: Ethereal Dream
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Dan Heng's ATK to one designated enemy target. If the attacked enemy is Slowed, the multiplier for the DMG dealt by Ultimate increases by ****2[i]%****.

skills.name: Superiority of Reach
skills.description: When Dan Heng becomes the target of an ally's ability, his next attack's Wind **RES PEN** increases by ****1[i]%****. This effect can be triggered again after **2[i]** turn(s).

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Splitting Spearhead
skills.description: After Dan Heng uses his Technique, his ATK increases by **1[i]%** at the start of the next battle for **2[i]** turn(s).

ranks.name: The Higher You Fly, the Harder You Fall
ranks.description: When the target enemy's current HP percentage is greater than or equal to **1[i]%**, CRIT Rate increases by **2[i]%**.

ranks.name: Quell the Venom Octet, Quench the Vice O'Flame
ranks.description: Reduces Talent cooldown by 1 turn.

ranks.name: Seen and Unseen
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Roaring Dragon and Soaring Sun
ranks.description: When Dan Heng uses his Ultimate to defeat an enemy, he will immediately take action again.

ranks.name: A Drop of Rain Feeds a Torrent
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: The Troubled Soul Lies in Wait
ranks.description: The Slow state triggered by Skill reduces the enemy's SPD by an extra **1[i]%**.

1003.name: Himeko
1003.description:
The one who repaired the Astral Express.
To witness the vast starry sky, she decided to travel with the Astral Express.
Her hobby is brewing hand-made coffee.

skills.name: Sawblade Tuning
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Himeko's ATK to one enemy.

skills.name: Molten Detonation
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Himeko's ATK to one designated enemy and Fire DMG equal to ****2[i]%**** of Himeko's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.

skills.name: Heavenly Flare
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Himeko's ATK to all enemies. Himeko regenerates **2[i]** extra Energy for each enemy defeated.

skills.name: Victory Rush
skills.description:
When an enemy target is inflicted with Weakness Break, Himeko gains 1 point of Charge (max **2[i]** points).
If Himeko is fully Charged when an ally target performs an attack, Himeko immediately performs 1 **Follow-Up ATK** and deals Fire DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of her ATK to all enemies, consuming all Charge points.
At the start of the battle, Himeko gains 1 point of Charge.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Incomplete Combustion
skills.description: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for **4[i]** second(s). After entering battle with enemies in the Special Dimension, there is a **1[i]%** **base chance** to increase Fire DMG taken by enemies by **2[i]%** for **3[i]** turn(s). Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

ranks.name: Childhood
ranks.description: After "Victory Rush" is triggered, Himeko's SPD increases by **1[i]%** for **2[i]** turn(s).

ranks.name: Convergence
ranks.description: Deals **2[i]%** more DMG to enemies whose HP percentage is **1[i]%** or less.

ranks.name: Poised
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Dedication
ranks.description: When Himeko's Skill inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, she gains **1[i]** extra point(s) of Charge.

ranks.name: Aspiration
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: Trailblaze!
ranks.description: Ultimate deals 2 extra instances of Fire DMG equal to **1[i]%** of the original DMG to one random enemy.

1004.name: Welt
1004.description:
A seasoned member of the Express Crew.
The passion buried in his heart burns anew as he enjoys this fresh adventure.
Occasionally, he would sketch the experiences in a notebook.

skills.name: Gravity Suppression
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Welt's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Edge of the Void
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Welt's ATK to one designated enemy and additionally deals 2 instances of DMG, with each time dealing Imaginary DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Welt's ATK to a random enemy. On hit, there is a ****2[i]%**** **base chance** to reduce the enemy's SPD by **3[i]%** for **4[i]** turn(s).

skills.name: Synthetic Black Hole
skills.description:
Deals Imaginary DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Welt's ATK to all enemies, with a **3[i]%** **base chance** for enemies hit by this ability to be Imprisoned for 1 turn.
Imprisoned enemies have their **actions delayed** by ****2[f1]%**** and SPD reduced by **4[i]%**.

skills.name: Time Distortion
skills.description: When hitting an enemy that is already Slowed, Welt deals Imaginary **Additional DMG** equal to ****1[i]%**** of his ATK to the enemy.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Gravitational Imprisonment
skills.description:
After using Welt's Technique, create a Special Dimension that lasts for **4[i]** second(s). Enemies in this Special Dimension have their movement speed reduced by **5[i]%**. After entering battle with enemies in the Special Dimension, there is a **1[i]%** **base chance** to Imprison the enemies for 1 turn.
Imprisoned enemies have their **actions delayed** by **2[i]%** and SPD reduced by **3[i]%**. Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

ranks.name: Legacy of Honor
ranks.description: After using Ultimate, Welt gets enhanced. Then, the next **3[i]** time(s) he uses Basic ATK or Skill, deals 1 extra instance of **Additional DMG** to the enemy target. The **Additional DMG** dealt when using Basic ATK is equal to **1[i]%** of Basic ATK DMG multiplier. The **Additional DMG** dealt when using Skill is equal to **2[i]%** of Skill DMG multiplier.

ranks.name: Conflux of Stars
ranks.description: When his Talent is triggered, Welt regenerates **1[i]** Energy.

ranks.name: Prayer of Peace
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Appellation of Justice
ranks.description: When using Skill, increases the **base chance** of reducing the attacked enemy target's SPD by **1[i]%**.

ranks.name: Power of Kindness
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: Prospect of Glory
ranks.description: When using Skill, deals DMG for 1 extra time to one random enemy.

1005.name: Kafka
1005.description:
A member of the Stellaron Hunters. A dashing, collected, and professional beauty.
Used the enchantment of Spirit Whisper to set up {NICKNAME to absorb the Stellaron.
Her hobby is shopping for and organizing her collection of coats.

skills.name: Midnight Tumult
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Kafka's ATK to a one designated enemy.

skills.name: Caressing Moonlight
skills.description:
Deals Lightning DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Kafka's ATK to a target enemy and Lightning DMG equal to ****3[i]%**** of Kafka's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.
If the target enemy is currently receiving DoT, all DoTs currently placed on that enemy immediately produce DMG equal to ****2[i]%**** of their original DMG.

skills.name: Twilight Trill
skills.description:
Deals Lightning DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Kafka's ATK to all enemies, with a **2[i]%** **base chance** for enemies hit to become Shocked and immediately take DMG from their current Shock state, equal to ****5[i]%**** of its original DMG. Shock lasts for **3[i]** turn(s).
While Shocked, enemies receive Lightning DoT equal to ****4[i]%**** of Kafka's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

skills.name: Gentle but Cruel
skills.description: After Kafka's teammate uses Basic ATK on an enemy target, Kafka immediately launches **Follow-Up ATK** and deals Lightning DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of her ATK to that target, with a **2[i]%** **base chance** to inflict Shock equivalent to that applied by her Ultimate to the attacked enemy target, lasting for **3[i]** turns. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per turn.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Mercy Is Not Forgiveness
skills.description: Immediately attacks all enemies within a set range. After entering battle, deals Lightning DMG equal to **3[i]%** of Kafka's ATK to all enemies, with a **1[i]%** **base chance** to inflict Shock equivalent to that applied by her Ultimate on every enemy target for **2[i]** turn(s).

ranks.name: Da Capo
ranks.description: When the Talent triggers a **Follow-Up ATK**, there is a **1[i]%** **base chance** to increase the DoT received by the target by **2[i]%** for **3[i]** turn(s).

ranks.name: Fortississimo
ranks.description: While Kafka is on the field, DoT dealt by all allies increases by **1[i]%**.

ranks.name: Capriccio
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Recitativo
ranks.description: When an enemy target takes DMG from the Shock status inflicted by Kafka, Kafka additionally regenerates **1[i]** Energy.

ranks.name: Doloroso
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: Leggiero
ranks.description: The Shock state inflicted on the enemy target by the Ultimate, Technique, or the Talent-triggered **Follow-Up ATK** has a DMG multiplier increase of **1[i]%** and lasts **2[i]** turn(s) longer.

1006.name: Silver Wolf
1006.description:
A member of the Stellaron Hunters and a genius hacker.
She sees the universe as a massive immersive simulation game and has fun with it.
She's mastered the skill known as "aether editing," which can be used to tamper with the data of reality.

skills.name: System Warning
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Silver Wolf's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Allow Changes?
skills.description:
There is a ****2[i]%**** **base chance** to add 1 Weakness of an on-field character's Type to the target enemy. This also reduces the enemy's DMG RES to that Weakness Type by **4[i]%** for **3[i]** turn(s). If the enemy already has that Type Weakness, the effect of DMG RES reduction to that Weakness Type will not be triggered.
Each enemy can only have 1 Weakness implanted by Silver Wolf. When Silver Wolf implants another Weakness to the target, only the most recent implanted Weakness will be kept.
In addition, there is a **5[i]%** **base chance** to further reduce the All-Type RES of the enemy by ****6[f1]%**** for **7[i]** turn(s).
Deals Quantum DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Silver Wolf's ATK to this enemy.

skills.name: User Banned
skills.description: There's a ****2[i]%**** **base chance** to decrease the target enemy's DEF by ****3[f1]%**** for **4[i]** turn(s). And at the same time, deals Quantum DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Silver Wolf's ATK to the target enemy.

skills.name: Awaiting System Response...
skills.description:
Silver Wolf can create three types of Bugs: Reduce ATK by ****1[f1]%****, reduce DEF by ****2[f1]%****, and reduce SPD by ****3[f1]%****.
Every time Silver Wolf attacks, she has a ****4[i]%**** **base chance** to implant a random Bug that lasts for **5[i]** turn(s) in an enemy target.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Force Quit Program
skills.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Quantum DMG equal to **1[i]%** of Silver Wolf's ATK to all enemies, and ignores Weakness Types and reduces Toughness from all enemies. Enemies with their Weakness Broken in this way will trigger the Quantum Weakness Break effect.

ranks.name: Social Engineering
ranks.description: After using her Ultimate to attack enemies, Silver Wolf regenerates **1[i]** Energy for every **debuff** that the target enemy currently has. This effect can be triggered up to **2[i]** time(s) in each use of her Ultimate.

ranks.name: Zombie Network
ranks.description: When an enemy enters combat, reduces their Effect RES by **1[i]%**.

ranks.name: Payload
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: Bounce Attack
ranks.description: After using her Ultimate to attack enemies, deals Quantum **Additional DMG** equal to **1[i]%** of Silver Wolf's ATK for every **debuff** currently on the enemy target. This effect can be triggered for a maximum of **2[i]** time(s) during each use of her Ultimate.

ranks.name: Brute Force Attack
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Overlay Network

The head of Herta Space Station's Security Department.
This quiet boy hopes to protect the researchers who value their pursuit of knowledge, and to help them to complete their work.

skills.name: Frenzied Punishment
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Arlan's ATK to one designated enemy and Lightning DMG equal to ****2[i]%**** of Arlan's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.

Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

1009.name: Asta
1009.description:
The lead researcher of Herta Space Station and a lady from a renowned family.
She's an astronomer overflowing with curiosity, and excels at managing the disparate staff of the space station.

skills.name: Spectrum Beam
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Asta's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Meteor Storm
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Asta's ATK to one designated enemy and further deals DMG for 4 extra times, with each time dealing Fire DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Asta's ATK to a random enemy.

skills.name: Astral Blessing
skills.description: Increases SPD of all allies by ****1[i]**** for **2[i]** turn(s).

skills.name: Astrometry
skills.description:
Gains 1 stack of Charging for every different enemy hit by Asta plus an extra stack if the enemy hit has Fire Weakness.
For every stack of Charging Asta has, all allies' ATK increases by ****1[f1]%****, up to **2[i]** time(s).
Starting from her second turn, Asta's Charging stack count is reduced by **3[i]** at the beginning of every turn.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Miracle Flash
skills.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Fire DMG equal to **1[i]%** of Asta's ATK to all enemies.

ranks.name: Star Sings Sans Verses or Vocals
ranks.description: When using Skill, deals DMG for 1 extra time to a random enemy.

ranks.name: Moon Speaks in Wax and Wane

ranks.name: Meteor Showers for Wish and Want
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.description: Charging stack(s) lost in each turn is reduced by **1[i]**.

Member **83** of the Genius Society. The real master of the space station.
An incredibly intelligent yet unsympathetic scientist.

skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Herta's ATK to one designated enemy.

ranks.name: Keep the Ball Rolling
ranks.description: Every time Talent is triggered, this character's CRIT Rate increases by **1[i]%**. This effect can stack up to **2[i]** time(s).

ranks.name: That's the Kind of Girl I Am
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Hit Where It Hurts
ranks.description: When Talent is triggered, DMG increases by **1[i]%**.

ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: No One Can Betray Me

1014.name: Saber
1014.description:
The solitary Heroic Spirit traverses the long night of fate. The banner of the round table remains unfurled in a dream. Alas, the knight-king of Camelot has yet to reach that ever-distant utopia.
Though still a young maiden, she has heeded the call for this most unique iteration of the Holy Grail War. With the Sword in the Stone offering its choice once more, how shall she shatter the illusions of the past?
— **"The wishes I did not fulfill will end here."**

skills.name: Invisible Air: Barrier of the Wind King
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of **Saber's** ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Strike Air: Hammer of the Wind King
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of **Saber's** ATK to one designated enemy, and deals Wind DMG equal to ****2[i]%**** of **Saber's** ATK to adjacent targets. If **Saber** currently holds "Core Resonance" and her Energy can be fully regenerated by consuming "Core Resonance" after this instance of Skill attack, then increases the multiplier for this instance of Skill. For every 1 point of "Core Resonance," increases the DMG multiplier for this instance of Skill by ****4[f1]%****. And after the attack, consumes all "Core Resonance" to regenerate Energy for **Saber**. Otherwise, immediately gains **3[i]** point(s) of "Core Resonance."

skills.name: Excalibur
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of **Saber's** ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals **3[i]** instance(s) of DMG, with each instance being Wind DMG equal to ****2[i]%**** of **Saber's** ATK dealt to one random enemy. After using Ultimate, the next Basic ATK switches to "Release, the Golden Scepter," and only "Release, the Golden Scepter" can be used.

skills.name: Dragon Reactor Core
skills.description: When entering combat, gains **8[i]** "Core Resonance" point(s). When any ally target uses Ultimate, increases the DMG dealt by **Saber** by ****3[i]%**** for **4[i]** turn(s) and gains **1[i]** "Core Resonance" point(s). For every 1 "Core Resonance" point consumed, regenerates a fixed amount of **5[f1]** Energy for **Saber**.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Behold, the King of Knights
skills.description: After using Technique, at the start of the next battle, increases **Saber's** ATK by **1[i]%** for **2[i]** turn(s) and gains **3[i]** "Core Resonance."

skills.name: Release, the Golden Scepter
skills.description: Gains **2[i]** point(s) of "Core Resonance" and deals Wind DMG to all enemies equal to ****1[i]%**** of **Saber's** ATK. When this ability is used, if the number of enemy targets is 2 or 1, additionally deals Wind DMG to all enemies equal to ****3[i]%**** or ****4[i]%**** of **Saber's** ATK respectively.

ranks.name: The Lost White Walls
ranks.description: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by **Saber** by **1[i]%**. After **Saber** uses Basic ATK or Skill, gains **2[i]** "Core Resonance."

ranks.name: The Lost Oath of the Round Table
ranks.description: For every 1 point of "Core Resonance" gained in this battle, **Saber**'s DMG dealt ignores **2[f1]%** of the target's DEF. This effect stacks up to **3[i]** time(s). When triggering the "Core Resonance" effect to boost Skill's multiplier, each point of "Core Resonance" additionally increases the DMG multiplier for the current instance of Skill by **1[i]%**.

ranks.name: A Wish Across Fifteen Centuries
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: The Saga of Sixteen Winter Days
ranks.description: Increases **Saber's** Wind **RES PEN** by **1[i]%**. After using Ultimate, increases **Saber's** Wind **RES PEN** by **2[i]%**. This effect stacks up to **3[i]** time(s).

ranks.name: The Dreamed Utopian Dawn
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: The Long Fated Night
ranks.description: The Wind **RES PEN** of the Ultimate DMG dealt by **Saber** increases by **1[i]%**. The amount of overflow Energy that can be accumulated with the Trace "Blessing of the Lake" increases to **4[i]**. After using Ultimate for the first time upon entering combat, regenerates a fixed amount of **3[i]** Energy for **Saber**. This effect can trigger 1 time after every **2[i]** Ultimate use(s).

1015.name: Archer
1015.description:
Despair plays in cycles between the past and future. Countless ideals were incinerated before that red garment. Yet, do not let this smear of ashes fool you —
Should someone create a phantasmal sweet dream under the guise of false ideals, then he will burn again, facing down the hypocrites of the world till the very end.
No matter where he is, he always remains the steadfast champion of justice.

skills.name: Kanshou and Bakuya
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of **Archer's** ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Caladbolg II: Fake Spiral Sword
skills.description: Enters the "Circuit Connection" state. Deals Quantum DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of **Archer's** ATK to one designated enemy. After using Skill in the "Circuit Connection" state, the current turn does not end, and the DMG dealt by **Archer's** Skill increases by ****2[i]%****. This effect can stack up to **3[i]** time(s), lasting until he exits the "Circuit Connection" state. After actively using Skill **5[i]** time(s) or when Skill Points are insufficient to use Skill again, exits the "Circuit Connection" state. After all enemy targets have been defeated in each wave, exits the "Circuit Connection" state.

skills.name: Unlimited Blade Works
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of **Archer's** ATK to one designated enemy and gains **2[i]** point(s) of Charge, up to a maximum of **3[i]**.

skills.name: Mind's Eye (True)
skills.description: After **Archer's** teammates attack enemy targets, **Archer** consumes 1 Charge and immediately launches **Follow-Up ATK** on the primary target, dealing Quantum DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of **Archer's** ATK and recovering 1 Skill Point. If the target is defeated before this **Follow-Up ATK** is launched, the **Follow-Up ATK** will be directed at one random enemy instead.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Clairvoyance
skills.description: Immediately attacks enemies. After entering combat, deals Quantum DMG equal to **1[i]%** of **Archer's** ATK to all enemies and gains **2[i]** point(s) of Charge.

skills.name: End
skills.description: Exits "Circuit Connection" state and ends the turn.

ranks.name: The Unreached Dream
ranks.description: After using Skill **1[i]** time(s) within one turn, recovers **2[i]** Skill Point(s) for allies.

ranks.name: The Unfulfilled Happiness
ranks.description: When using Ultimate, reduces the enemy target's Quantum RES by **1[i]%**, and applies Quantum Weakness to it, lasting for **2[i]** turn(s).

ranks.name: The Untamed Will
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: The Unsung Life
ranks.description: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by **1[i]%**.

ranks.name: The Nameless Watch
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: The Endless Pilgrimage
ranks.description: When the turn starts, recovers 1 Skill Point for allies. The maximum number of stacks allowed for the DMG boost effect provided by this unit's Skill increases by **1[i]**. The Skill DMG dealt ignores **2[i]%** of DEF.

1101.name: Bronya
1101.description:
Heir apparent to the Supreme Guardian of Belobog.
She possesses pride befitting of a princess, but also the determination and integrity of a soldier.

skills.name: Windrider Bullet
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Bronya's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Combat Redeployment
skills.description:
Dispels a **debuff** from a single ally, allows them to immediately take action, and increases their DMG by ****1[i]%**** for **3[i]** turn(s).
When this Skill is used on Bronya herself, she cannot immediately take action again.

skills.name: The Belobog March
skills.description: Increases the ATK of all allies by ****1[i]%****, and increases their CRIT DMG equal to ****2[f1]%**** of Bronya's CRIT DMG plus ****3[f1]%**** for **4[i]** turn(s).

skills.name: Leading the Way
skills.description: After using her Basic ATK, Bronya's next action will be **Advanced Forward** by ****1[i]%****.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Banner of Command
skills.description: After using Bronya's Technique, at the start of the next battle, all allies' ATK increases by **1[i]%** for **2[i]** turn(s).

ranks.name: Hone Your Strength
ranks.description: When using Skill, there is a **1[i]%** **fixed chance** of recovering 1 Skill Point. This effect has a 1-turn cooldown.

ranks.name: Quick March
ranks.description: When using Skill, the target ally's SPD increases by **1[i]%** after taking action, lasting for 1 turn.

ranks.name: Bombardment
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: Take by Surprise
ranks.description: After any other ally character uses Basic ATK on an enemy target that has Wind Weakness, Bronya immediately launches 1 instance of **Follow-Up ATK**, dealing Wind DMG to this target equal to **1[i]%** of her Basic ATK DMG. This effect can only trigger once per turn.

ranks.name: Unstoppable
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Piercing Rainbow
ranks.description: The duration of the DMG Boost effect placed by the Skill on the target ally increases by **1[i]** turn(s).

1102.name: Seele
1102.description:
A resident of the Underworld and the backbone of Wildfire. She goes by the alias "Babochka."
She has a frank personality, but there is a delicate and sensitive hidden side to her deep in her heart.

skills.name: Thwack
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Seele's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Sheathed Blade
skills.description: Increases Seele's SPD by **2[i]%** for **3[i]** turn(s) and deals Quantum DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Seele's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Butterfly Flurry
skills.description: Seele enters the Amplification state and deals Quantum DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of her ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Resurgence
skills.description:
Enters the Amplification state upon defeating an enemy with Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate, and receives an **extra turn**. While in the Amplification state, increases the DMG of Seele's attacks by ****1[i]%**** for **2[i]** turn(s).
Enemies defeated in the **extra turn** provided by "Resurgence" will not trigger another "Resurgence."

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Phantom Illusion
skills.description: After using her Technique, Seele gains Stealth for **1[i]** second(s). While Stealth is active, Seele cannot be detected by enemies. And when entering battle by attacking enemies, Seele will immediately enter the Amplification state.

ranks.name: Extirpating Slash
ranks.description: When dealing DMG to an enemy whose HP percentage is **1[i]%** or lower, increases CRIT Rate by **2[i]%**.

ranks.name: Dancing Butterfly
ranks.description: The SPD Boost effect of Seele's Skill can stack up to **1[i]** time(s).

ranks.name: Dazzling Tumult
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: Flitting Phantasm
ranks.description: Seele regenerates **1[i]** Energy when she defeats an enemy.

ranks.name: Piercing Shards
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Shattering Shambles
ranks.description:
After attacking with Ultimate, Seele inflicts "Butterfly Flurry" on the attacked enemy target for **2[i]** turn(s). Enemies in "Butterfly Flurry" will additionally take 1 instance of Quantum **Additional DMG** equal to **1[i]%** of Seele's Ultimate DMG every time they are attacked. If the target is defeated by the "Butterfly Flurry" state's **Additional DMG** triggered by other allies' attacks, Seele's Talent will not be triggered.
When Seele is **knocked down**, the "Butterfly Flurry" inflicted on the enemies will be removed.

1103.name: Serval
1103.description:
A Belobog mechanic who used to be a researcher for the Technology Division of the Architects.
As Gepard Landau's elder sister, her personality stands in stark contrast to her brother's.
She loves an ancient form of music known as "rock 'n' roll" that was popular before the Eternal Freeze.

skills.name: Roaring Thunderclap
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Serval's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Lightning Flash
skills.description:
Deals Lightning DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Serval's ATK to one designated enemy and Lightning DMG equal to ****2[i]%**** of Serval's ATK to enemies adjacent to it, with a **3[i]%** **base chance** for enemies hit to become Shocked for **4[i]** turn(s).
While Shocked, enemies take Lightning DoT equal to ****5[i]%**** of Serval's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

skills.name: Here Comes the Mechanical Fever
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Serval's ATK to all enemies. Enemies already Shocked will extend the duration of their Shock state by **2[i]** turn(s).

skills.name: Galvanic Chords
skills.description: After Serval attacks, deals Lightning **Additional DMG** equal to ****1[i]%**** of Serval's ATK to all Shocked enemies.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Good Night, Belobog
skills.description:
Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Lightning DMG equal to **4[i]%** of Serval's ATK to a random enemy, with a **1[i]%** **base chance** for all enemies to become Shocked for **3[i]** turn(s).
While Shocked, enemies will take Lightning DoT equal to **2[i]%** of Serval's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

ranks.name: Echo Chamber
ranks.description: Basic ATK deals Lightning DMG equal to **1[i]%** of Basic ATK DMG to a random target adjacent to the target enemy.

ranks.name: Encore!
ranks.description: Every time Serval's Talent is triggered to deal **Additional DMG**, she regenerates **1[i]** Energy.

ranks.name: Listen, the Heartbeat of the Gears
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Make Some Noise!
ranks.description: Ultimate has a **1[i]%** **base chance** to apply Shock to any enemies not currently Shocked. This Shock has the same effects as the one applied by Skill.

ranks.name: Belobog's Loudest Roar!
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: This Song Rocks to Heaven!
ranks.description: Serval deals **1[i]%** more DMG to Shocked enemies.

1104.name: Gepard
1104.description:
A captain in the Silvermane Guards and an outstanding warrior of Belobog.
He is meticulous and vigilant to the core and is always true to himself.

skills.name: Fist of Conviction
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Gepard's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Daunting Smite
skills.description:
Deals Ice DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Gepard's ATK to one designated enemy, with a **2[i]%** **base chance** to Freeze the enemy for **3[i]** turn(s).
While Frozen, the enemy cannot take action and will take Ice **Additional DMG** equal to ****4[i]%**** of Gepard's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

skills.name: Enduring Bulwark
skills.description: Applies a Shield to all allies, absorbing DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Gepard's DEF plus ****3[i]**** for **2[i]** turn(s).

skills.name: Unyielding Will
skills.description: When struck with a killing blow, instead of becoming **knocked down**, Gepard's HP immediately restores to ****1[i]%**** of his Max HP. This effect can only trigger once per battle.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Comradery
skills.description: After Gepard uses his Technique, when the next battle begins, a Shield will be applied to all allies, absorbing DMG equal to **1[i]%** of Gepard's DEF plus **3[i]** for **2[i]** turn(s).

ranks.name: Due Diligence
ranks.description: When using Skill, increases the **base chance** to Freeze the attacked target enemy by **1[i]%**.

ranks.name: Lingering Cold
ranks.description: After an enemy Frozen by Skill is unfrozen, their SPD is reduced by **1[i]%** for **2[i]** turn(s).

ranks.name: Never Surrender
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: Faith Moves Mountains
ranks.description: When Gepard is in battle, all allies' Effect RES increases by **1[i]%**.

ranks.name: Cold Iron Fist
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Unyielding Resolve
ranks.description: When his Talent is triggered, Gepard immediately takes action and restores extra HP equal to **1[i]%** of his Max HP.

1105.name: Natasha
1105.description:
A doctor from the Underworld and a caregiver of children.
Alongside her kindness and caring, she also has a hidden dangerous side.

skills.name: Behind the Kindness
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Natasha's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Love, Heal, and Choose
skills.description: Restores a single ally for ****1[f1]%**** of Natasha's Max HP plus ****4[i]****. Restores the ally for another ****2[f1]%**** of Natasha's Max HP plus ****5[i]**** at the beginning of each turn for **3[i]** turn(s).

skills.name: Gift of Rebirth
skills.description: Heals all allies for ****1[f1]%**** of Natasha's Max HP plus ****2[i]****.

skills.name: Innervation
skills.description: When healing allies with HP percentage at **1[i]%** or lower, increases Natasha's Outgoing Healing by ****2[i]%****. This effect also works on continuous healing.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Hypnosis Research
skills.description:
Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Physical DMG equal to **4[i]%** of Natasha's ATK to a random enemy, with a **1[i]%** **base chance** to Weaken all enemies.
While Weakened, enemies deal **2[i]%** less DMG to allies for **3[i]** turn(s).

ranks.name: Pharmacology Expertise
ranks.description: After being attacked, if the current HP percentage is **1[i]%** or lower, heals self for 1 time to restore HP by an amount equal to **2[i]%** of Max HP plus **3[i]**. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per battle.

ranks.name: Clinical Research
ranks.description: When Natasha uses her Ultimate, grant continuous healing for **2[i]** turn(s) to allies whose HP percentage is at **1[i]%** or lower. And at the beginning of their turn, their HP is restored by an amount equal to **3[i]%** of Natasha's Max HP plus **4[i]**.

ranks.name: The Right Cure
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Miracle Cure
ranks.description: After being attacked, regenerates **1[i]** extra Energy.

ranks.name: Preventive Treatment
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: Doctor's Grace
ranks.description: Natasha's Basic ATK additionally deals Physical DMG equal to **1[i]%** of her Max HP.

1106.name: Pela
1106.description:
An intelligence officer for the Silvermane Guards.
She has a serious personality and is revered by other members of the Silvermane Guards.

skills.name: Frost Shot
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Pela's ATK to one designated enemy target.

skills.name: Frostbite
skills.description: Removes **2[i]** **buff(s)** and deals Ice DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Pela's ATK to one designated target enemy.

skills.name: Zone Suppression
skills.description:
Deals Ice DMG equal to ****4[i]%**** of Pela's ATK to all enemies, with a **1[i]%** **base chance** to inflict Exposed on all enemies.
When Exposed, enemies' DEF is reduced by ****2[i]%**** for **3[i]** turn(s).

skills.name: Data Collecting
skills.description: If the enemy is **debuffed** after Pela's attack, Pela will restore ****1[f1]**** additional Energy. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per attack.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Preemptive Strike
skills.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, Pela deals Ice DMG equal to **4[i]%** of her ATK to a random enemy, with a **1[i]%** **base chance** of lowering the DEF of all enemies by **2[i]%** for **3[i]** turn(s).

ranks.name: Victory Report
ranks.description: When an enemy is defeated, Pela regenerates **1[i]** Energy.

ranks.name: Adamant Charge
ranks.description: Using Skill to dispel **buff(s)** increases SPD by **1[i]%** for **2[i]** turn(s).

ranks.name: Suppressive Force
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Full Analysis
ranks.description: When using Skill, there is a **1[i]%** **base chance** to reduce the target enemy's Ice RES by **2[i]%** for **3[i]** turn(s).

ranks.name: Absolute Jeopardy
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: Feeble Pursuit
ranks.description: After Pela attacks, if the enemy target is **debuffed**, deals Ice **Additional DMG** equal to **1[i]%** of Pela's ATK to the enemy.

1107.name: Clara
1107.description:
A vagrant girl who lives with robots.
She is introverted, gentle, and has a pure heart.
She wishes for all Underworlders to become a family.

skills.name: I Want to Help
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Clara's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Svarog Watches Over You
skills.description:
Deals Physical DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Clara's ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals Physical DMG equal to ****2[i]%**** of Clara's ATK to enemies marked by Svarog with a Mark of Counter.
All Marks of Counter will be removed after this Skill is used.

skills.name: Promise, Not Command
skills.description:
After Clara uses Ultimate, DMG dealt to her is reduced by an extra ****4[i]%****, and she has greatly increased chances of being attacked by enemies for **3[i]** turn(s).
In addition, Svarog's **Counter** is enhanced. When an ally is attacked, Svarog immediately launches a **Counter**, and its DMG multiplier against the enemy increases by ****2[i]%****. Enemies adjacent to it take **50%** of the DMG dealt to the primary target enemy. Enhanced **Counter(s)** can take effect **5[i]** time(s).

skills.name: Because We're Family
skills.description: Under the protection of Svarog, DMG taken by Clara when hit by enemy attacks is reduced by **3[i]%**. Svarog will mark enemies who attack Clara with his Mark of Counter and retaliate with a **Counter**, dealing Physical DMG equal to ****2[i]%**** of Clara's ATK.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: A Small Price for Victory
skills.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, the chance Clara will be attacked by enemies increases for **1[i]** turn(s).

ranks.name: A Tall Figure
ranks.description: Using Skill will not remove Marks of Counter on the enemy.

ranks.name: A Tight Embrace
ranks.description: After using the Ultimate, ATK increases by **1[i]%** for **2[i]** turn(s).

ranks.name: Cold Steel Armor
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Family's Warmth
ranks.description: After Clara is hit, the DMG taken by Clara is reduced by **1[i]%**. This effect lasts until the start of her next turn.

ranks.name: A Small Promise
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: Long Company
ranks.description: After other allies are attacked, Svarog also has a **1[i]%** **fixed chance** to trigger a **Counter** on the attacker and mark them with a "Mark of Counter." When using Ultimate, the number of Enhanced Counters increases by **2[i]**.

1108.name: Sampo
1108.description:
A merchant who freely travels between the Overworld and the Underworld.
He acts like he is everyone's friend, is enthusiastically humorous, and is good at bantering.

skills.name: Dazzling Blades
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Sampo's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Ricochet Love
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to ****2[i]%**** of Sampo's ATK to one designated enemy, and further deals DMG for **1[i]** extra time(s), with each time dealing Wind DMG equal to ****2[i]%**** of Sampo's ATK to a random enemy.

skills.name: Surprise Present
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Sampo's ATK to all enemies, with a **4[i]%** **base chance** to increase the targets' DoT taken by ****2[i]%**** for **3[i]** turn(s).

skills.name: Windtorn Dagger
skills.description:
Sampo's attacks have a **1[i]%** **base chance** to inflict Wind Shear for **3[i]** turn(s).
Enemies inflicted with Wind Shear will take Wind DoT equal to ****2[i]%**** of Sampo's ATK at the beginning of each turn. Wind Shear can stack up to **4[i]** time(s).

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Shining Bright
skills.description:
After Sampo uses his Technique, enemies in a set area are afflicted with Blind for **1[i]** second(s). Blinded enemies cannot detect ally targets.
When initiating combat against a Blinded enemy, there is a **2[i]%** **fixed chance** to **delay all enemies' action** by **3[i]%**.

ranks.name: Rising Love
ranks.description: When using Skill, deals DMG for **1[i]** extra time(s) to a random enemy.

ranks.name: Infectious Enthusiasm
ranks.description: Defeating an enemy afflicted with Wind Shear has a **1[i]%** **base chance** to inflict all enemies with **2[i]** stack(s) of Wind Shear, equivalent to that of Skill.

ranks.name: Big Money!
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: The Deeper the Love, the Stronger the Hate
ranks.description: When Skill hits an enemy with **1[i]** or more stack(s) of Wind Shear, the enemy immediately takes **2[i]%** of current Wind Shear DMG.

ranks.name: Huuuuge Money!
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: Increased Spending
ranks.description: Talent's Wind Shear DMG multiplier increases by **1[i]%**.

1109.name: Hook
1109.description:
Boss (self-proclaimed) of an Underworld adventure squad, The Moles.
She loves freedom and sees life as a series of adventures.

skills.name: Hehe! Don't Get Burned!
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Hook's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Hey! Remember Hook?
skills.description:
Deals Fire DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Hook's ATK to one designated enemy. In addition, there is a **2[i]%** **base chance** to inflict Burn for **3[i]** turn(s).
When afflicted with Burn, enemies will take Fire DoT equal to ****4[i]%**** of Hook's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

skills.name: Boom! Here Comes the Fire!
skills.description:
Deals Fire DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Hook's ATK to one designated enemy.
After using Ultimate, the next Skill to be used is Enhanced, which deals DMG to one designated enemy and enemies adjacent to it.

skills.name: Ha! Oil to the Flames!
skills.description: When attacking a target afflicted with Burn, deals Fire **Additional DMG** equal to ****1[i]%**** of Hook's ATK and regenerates **2[i]** extra Energy.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Ack! Look at This Mess!
skills.description:
Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, Hook deals Fire DMG equal to **4[i]%** of her ATK to a random enemy. In addition, there is a **1[i]%** **base chance** to inflict Burn on every enemy for **3[i]** turn(s).
When afflicted with Burn, enemies will take Fire DoT equal to **2[i]%** of Hook's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

skills.name: Hey! Remember Hook?
skills.description:
Deals Fire DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Hook's ATK to one designated enemy, with a **2[i]%** **base chance** to Burn them for **3[i]** turn(s). Additionally, deals Fire DMG equal to ****5[i]%**** of Hook's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.
When afflicted with Burn, enemies will take Fire DoT equal to ****4[i]%**** of Hook's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

ranks.name: Early to Bed, Early to Rise
ranks.description: Enhanced Skill deals **1[i]%** increased DMG.

ranks.name: Happy Tummy, Happy Body
ranks.description: Extends the duration of Burn caused by Skill by **1[i]** turn(s).

ranks.name: Don't Be Picky, Nothing's Icky
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: It's Okay to Not Know
ranks.description: When Talent is triggered, there is a **1[i]%** **base chance** to Burn enemies adjacent to the designated enemy target, equivalent to that of Skill.

ranks.name: Let the Moles' Deeds Be Known
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: Always Ready to Punch and Kick
ranks.description: Hook deals **1[i]%** more DMG to enemies afflicted with Burn.

1110.name: Lynx
1110.description:
A Belobogian Snow Plains Explorer, and the youngest of the Landau siblings.
Calm and collected, with a strong drive for action. Often embarks on solo adventures to explore the snowy wilderness.

skills.name: Ice Crampon Technique
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of this character's Max HP to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Salted Camping Cans
skills.description:
Applies "Survival Response" to a single target ally and increases their Max HP by ****1[f1]%**** of Lynx's Max HP plus ****2[i]****. If the target ally is a character on the Path of Destruction or Preservation, the chance of them being attacked by enemies will greatly increase. "Survival Response" lasts for **3[i]** turn(s).
Restores the target's HP by ****4[f1]%**** of Lynx's Max HP plus ****5[i]****.

skills.name: Snowfield First Aid
skills.description: Dispels **1[i]** **debuff(s)** from all allies and immediately restores their respective HP by an amount equal to ****2[f1]%**** of Lynx's Max HP plus ****3[i]****.

skills.name: Outdoor Survival Experience
skills.description: When using Lynx's Skill or Ultimate, applies continuous healing to the target ally for **1[i]** turn(s), restoring the target ally's HP by an amount equal to ****2[f1]%**** of Lynx's Max HP plus ****3[i]**** at the start of each turn. If the target has "Survival Response," the continuous healing effect additionally restores HP by an amount equal to ****4[f1]%**** of Lynx's Max HP plus ****5[i]****.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Chocolate Energy Bar
skills.description: After Lynx uses her Technique, at the start of the next battle, all allies are granted her Talent's continuous healing effect, lasting for **1[i]** turn(s).

ranks.name: Morning of Snow Hike
ranks.description: When healing allies with HP percentage equal to or lower than **1[i]%**, Lynx's Outgoing Healing increases by **2[i]%**. This effect also works on continuous healing.

ranks.name: Noon of Portable Furnace
ranks.description: A target with "Survival Response" can resist **debuff** application for **1[i]** time(s).

ranks.name: Afternoon of Avalanche Beacon
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Dusk of Warm Campfire
ranks.description: When "Survival Response" is gained, increases the target's ATK by an amount equal to **1[f1]%** of Lynx's Max HP for **2[i]** turn(s).

ranks.name: Night of Aurora Tea
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: Dawn of Explorers' Chart
ranks.description: Additionally boosts the Max HP increasing effect of "Survival Response" by an amount equal to **1[f1]%** of Lynx's Max HP and increases Effect RES by **2[i]%**.

ranks.name: Extirpating Slash
ranks.description: When dealing DMG to an enemy whose HP percentage is **1[i]%** or lower, increases CRIT Rate by **2[i]%**, and ignores **3[i]%** of target's DEF.

ranks.name: Dancing Butterfly
ranks.description: The SPD Boost effect of Seele's Skill can stack up to **1[i]** time(s).

ranks.name: Dazzling Tumult
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: Flitting Phantasm
ranks.description: Seele regenerates **1[i]** Energy when she defeats an enemy.

ranks.name: Piercing Shards
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Shattering Shambles
ranks.description:
After attacking with Ultimate, Seele inflicts "Butterfly Flurry" on the target for **2[i]** turn(s). Enemy targets in "Butterfly Flurry" will additionally take 1 instance of **True DMG** equal to **1[i]%** of Seele's Ultimate DMG after receiving an attack. When the target under the "Butterfly Flurry" state is defeated by any unit, Seele's Talent will also be triggered.
When Seele is **knocked down**, the "Butterfly Flurry" inflicted on the enemies will be removed.

1111.name: Luka
1111.description:
The boxing champion in Belobog's Underworld, and one of Wildfire's most capable fighters.
The consecutive reigning champion of the Fight Club, whose enthusiasm inspires children of the Underworld to dream big.

skills.name: Direct Punch
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Luka's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Lacerating Fist
skills.description:
Deals Physical DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Luka's ATK to one designated enemy target. In addition, there is a **2[i]%** **base chance** to inflict Bleed on them, lasting for **5[i]** turn(s).
While Bleeding, the enemy will take **3[f1]%** of their Max HP as Physical DoT at the start of each turn. This DMG will not exceed more than ****4[i]%**** of Luka's ATK.

skills.name: Coup de Grâce
skills.description: Receives **5[i]** stack(s) of "Fighting Will," with a **2[i]%** **base chance** to increase one designated enemy target's DMG received by ****3[f1]%**** for **4[i]** turn(s). Then, deals Physical DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Luka's ATK to the target.

skills.name: Flying Sparks
skills.description: After Luka uses his Basic ATK "Direct Punch" or Skill "Lacerating Fist," he receives **1[i]** stack of Fighting Will, up to 4 stacks. When he has 2 or more stacks of Fighting Will, his Basic ATK "Direct Punch" is enhanced to "Sky-Shatter Fist." After his Enhanced Basic ATK's "Rising Uppercut" hits a Bleeding enemy target, the Bleed status will immediately deal DMG for 1 time equal to ****2[i]%**** of the original DMG to the target. At the start of battle, Luka will possess 1 stack of Fighting Will.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Anticipator
skills.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, Luka deals Physical DMG equal to **1[i]%** of his ATK to a random single enemy with a **2[i]%** **base chance** to inflict his Skill's Bleed effect on the target. Then, Luka gains 1 additional stack of Fighting Will.

skills.name: Sky-Shatter Fist
skills.description:
Consumes 2 stacks of "Fighting Will." First, uses "Direct Punch" to deal 3 hits, with each hit dealing Physical DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Luka's ATK to one designated enemy target.
Then, uses "Rising Uppercut" to deal 1 hit, dealing Physical DMG equal to ****2[i]%**** of Luka's ATK to the designated enemy target.

ranks.name: Fighting Endlessly
ranks.description: When Luka takes action, if the target enemy is Bleeding, increases DMG dealt by Luka by **1[i]%** for **2[i]** turn(s).

ranks.name: The Enemy is Weak, I am Strong
ranks.description: If the Skill hits an enemy target with Physical Weakness, gain **1[i]** stack(s) of Fighting Will.

ranks.name: Born for the Ring
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: Never Turning Back
ranks.description: For every stack of Fighting Will obtained, increases ATK by **1[i]%**, stacking up to **2[i]** time(s).

ranks.name: The Spirit of Wildfire
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: A Champion's Applause
ranks.description: After the Enhanced Basic ATK's "Rising Uppercut" hits a Bleeding enemy target, the Bleed status will immediately deal DMG 1 time equal to **1[i]%** of the original DMG for every hit of Direct Punch already unleashed during the current Enhanced Basic ATK.

1112.name: Topaz & Numby
1112.description:
Topaz is the Leader of the Special Debts Picket Team and high-level manager of the Strategic Investment Department under the Interastral Peace Corporation.
A member of the "Ten Stonehearts" at a young age, Topaz's foundational expertise is "debt retrieval."
Her partner, the Warp Trotter "Numby," is also capable of keenly perceiving where "riches" are located, ensuring that jobs based in security, debt collection, and actuarial varieties are of no great challenge.
At presently they are traveling the cosmos together, seeking all manner of liability disputes that might be affecting the stable progression of the IPC's businesses.

skills.name: Deficit...
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Topaz's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Difficulty Paying?
skills.description:
Inflicts one designated enemy target with a "Proof of Debt" state, increasing the **Follow-Up ATK** DMG it receives by ****2[i]%****. "Proof of Debt" only takes effect on the most recent target it is applied to. If there are no enemies inflicted with "Proof of Debt" on the field when an ally's turn starts or when an ally takes action, Topaz will inflict a random enemy with "Proof of Debt."
Numby deals Fire DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Topaz's ATK to this target. Using this Skill to deal DMG is considered as launching a **Follow-Up ATK**.

skills.name: Turn a Profit!
skills.description: Numby enters the Windfall Bonanza! state and its DMG multiplier increases by ****1[i]%**** and CRIT DMG increases by ****2[i]%****. Also, when enemies with Proof of Debt are hit by an ally's Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate, Numby's action is Advanced Forward by **3[i]%**. Numby exits the Windfall Bonanza! state after using **4[i]** attacks.

skills.name: Trotter Market!?
skills.description:
Summons Numby at the start of battle. Numby has **1[i]** SPD by default. When taking action, Numby launches **Follow-Up ATKs** on one enemy target afflicted with "Proof of Debt," dealing Fire DMG equal to ****2[i]%**** of Topaz's ATK.
When enemies afflicted with "Proof of Debt" receive an ally's Follow-Up ATKs, Numby's action is Advanced Forward by **3[i]%**. The action Advance Forward effect cannot be triggered during Numby's own turn.
When Topaz is **downed**, Numby disappears.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Explicit Subsidy
skills.description:
Summons Numby when Topaz enters the overworld. Numby will automatically search for Basic Treasures and Trotters within a set radius.
Using her Technique will regenerate **1[i]** Energy for Topaz after Numby's first attack in the next battle.
If Topaz is still in the team after using her Technique and defeating overworld enemies, a small bonus amount of credits will be added to the earned credits. A maximum of **2[i]** bonus credits can be received per calendar day.
After using her Technique and defeating enemies in Simulated Universe or Divergent Universe, additionally receive a small amount of Cosmic Fragments with a small chance to obtain 1 random Curio.

ranks.name: Future Market
ranks.description:
When enemies afflicted with "Proof of Debt" receive **Follow-Up ATKs**, they will enter the "Debtor" state. This can take effect only once within a single attack.
The "Debtor" state increases the CRIT DMG of **Follow-Up ATKs** inflicted on the enemy target by **1[i]%**, stacking up to **2[i]** time(s). When "Proof of Debt" is removed, the "Debtor" state is also removed.

ranks.name: Bona Fide Acquisition
ranks.description: After Numby takes action and launches an attack, Topaz regenerates **1[i]** Energy.

ranks.name: Seize the Big and Free the Small
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Agile Operation
ranks.description: After Numby's turn begins, Topaz's **action advances** by **1[i]%**.

ranks.name: Inflationary Demand
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: Incentive Mechanism
ranks.description: Numby's attack count during the "Windfall Bonanza!" state increases by **1[i]**, and its Fire **RES PEN** increases by **2[i]%** when it attacks.

1201.name: Qingque
1201.description:
Diviner of the Divination Commission on the Xianzhou Luofu, and a librarian.
Always slacks off and is about to be demoted to a "door guardian."

skills.name: Flower Pick
skills.description: Tosses 1 jade tile from the suit with the fewest tiles in hand to deal Quantum DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Qingque's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: A Scoop of Moon
skills.description: Immediately draws **1[i]** jade tile(s) and increases DMG by ****2[i]%**** until the end of the current turn. This effect can stack up to **3[i]** time(s). The turn will not end after this Skill is used.

skills.name: A Quartet? Woo-hoo!
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Qingque's ATK to all enemies, and obtains 4 jade tiles of the same suit.

skills.name: Celestial Jade
skills.description:
When an ally's turn starts, Qingque randomly draws 1 tile from 3 different suits and can hold up to 4 tiles at one time.
If Qingque starts her turn with 4 tiles of the same suit, she consumes all tiles to enter the "Hidden Hand" state.
While in this state, Qingque cannot use her Skill again. At the same time, Qingque's ATK increases by ****1[i]%****, and her Basic ATK "Flower Pick" is enhanced, becoming "Cherry on Top!" The "Hidden Hand" state ends after using "Cherry on Top!".

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Game Solitaire
skills.description: After using Technique, Qingque draws **1[i]** jade tile(s) when the battle starts.

skills.name: Cherry on Top!
skills.description:
Deals Quantum DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Qingque's ATK to one designated enemy, and deals Quantum DMG equal to ****2[i]%**** of Qingque's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.
"Cherry on Top!" cannot recover Skill Points.

ranks.name: Rise Through the Tiles
ranks.description: Ultimate deals **1[i]%** more DMG.

ranks.name: Sleep on the Tiles
ranks.description: Every time Draw Tile is triggered, Qingque immediately regenerates **1[i]** Energy.

ranks.name: Read Between the Tiles
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: Right on the Tiles
ranks.description:
After using Skill, there is a **1[i]%** **fixed chance** to gain "Self-Sufficer," lasting until the end of the current turn. 
While "Self-Sufficer" is active, using Basic ATK or Enhanced Basic ATK immediately launches 1 **Follow-Up ATK** on the same target, dealing Quantum DMG equal to **100%** of Basic ATK DMG or Enhanced Basic ATK DMG.

ranks.name: Gambit for the Tiles
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Prevail Beyond the Tiles
ranks.description: Recovers 1 Skill Point after using Enhanced Basic ATK.

1202.name: Tingyun
1202.description:
Amicassador of the Sky-Faring Commission of the Xianzhou Luofu.
She travels with business delegates, forging trade relationships and alliances with many worlds.

skills.name: Dislodged
skills.description: Tingyun deals Lightning DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of her ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Soothing Melody
skills.description:
Grants a single ally with Benediction to increase their ATK by ****2[i]%****, up to ****4[i]%**** of Tingyun's current ATK.
When the ally with Benediction attacks, they will deal Lightning **Additional DMG** equal to ****1[i]%**** of that ally's ATK for 1 time.
Benediction lasts for **3[i]** turn(s) and is only effective on the most recent receiver of Tingyun's Skill.

skills.name: Amidst the Rejoicing Clouds
skills.description: Regenerates **1[i]** Energy for a single ally and increases the target's DMG by ****3[i]%**** for **2[i]** turn(s).

skills.name: Violet Sparknado
skills.description: When an enemy is attacked by Tingyun, the ally with Benediction immediately deals Lightning **Additional DMG** equal to ****1[i]%**** of that ally's ATK to the same enemy.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Gentle Breeze
skills.description: Tingyun immediately regenerates **1[i]** Energy upon using her Technique.

ranks.name: Windfall of Lucky Springs
ranks.description: After using their Ultimate, the ally with Benediction gains a **1[i]%** increase in SPD for 1 turn.

ranks.name: Gainfully Gives, Givingly Gains
ranks.description: The ally with Benediction regenerates **1[i]** Energy after defeating an enemy. This effect can only be triggered once per turn.

ranks.name: Halcyon Bequest
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Jovial Versatility
ranks.description: The DMG multiplier provided by Benediction increases by **1[i]%**.

ranks.name: Sauntering Coquette
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: Peace Brings Wealth to All
ranks.description: Ultimate regenerates **1[i]** more Energy for the target ally.

1203.name: Luocha
1203.description:
Carrying a coffin wherever he goes, he is a foreign trader who came from beyond the stellar seas.
Has excellent medical skills.

skills.name: Thorns of the Abyss
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Luocha's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Prayer of Abyss Flower
skills.description:
After using his Skill, Luocha immediately restores the target ally's HP equal to ****1[i]%**** of Luocha's ATK plus ****2[i]****. Meanwhile, Luocha gains 1 stack of Abyss Flower.
When any ally's HP percentage drops to **3[i]%** or lower, an effect equivalent to Luocha's Skill will immediately be triggered and applied to this ally for one time (without consuming Skill Points). This effect can be triggered again after **4[i]** turn(s).

skills.name: Death Wish
skills.description: Removes **2[i]** **buff(s)** from all enemies and deals all enemies Imaginary DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Luocha's ATK. At the same time, Luocha gains 1 stack of Abyss Flower.

skills.name: Cycle of Life
skills.description:
When Abyss Flower reaches **1[i]** stacks, Luocha consumes all stacks of Abyss Flower to deploy a Zone against the enemy.
When any enemy in the Zone is attacked by an ally, the attacking ally's HP is immediately restored by an amount equal to ****2[f1]%**** of Luocha's ATK plus ****4[i]****.
The Zone's effect lasts for **3[i]** turns. When Luocha is **knocked down**, the Zone will be dispelled.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Mercy of a Fool
skills.description: After the Technique is used, the Talent will be immediately triggered at the start of the next battle.

ranks.name: Ablution of the Quick
ranks.description: While the Zone is active, ATK of all allies increases by **1[i]%**.

ranks.name: Bestowal From the Pure
ranks.description: When his Skill is triggered, if the target ally's HP percentage is lower than **50%**, Luocha's Outgoing Healing increases by **1[i]%**. If the target ally's HP percentage is at **50%** or higher, the ally receives a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to **2[i]%** of Luocha's ATK plus **3[i]**, lasting for **4[i]** turns.

ranks.name: Surveyal by the Fool
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Heavy Lies the Crown
ranks.description: When Luocha's Zone is active, enemies become Weakened and deal **1[i]%** less DMG.

ranks.name: Cicatrix 'Neath the Pain
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: Reunion With the Dust
ranks.description: When Ultimate is used, there is a **1[i]%** **fixed chance** to reduce all enemies' All-Type RES by **2[i]%** for **3[i]** turn(s).

1204.name: Jing Yuan
1204.description:
The Divine Foresight, one of the Seven Arbiter-Generals of the Xianzhou Alliance, leads the Cloud Knights of the Xianzhou Luofu.
A student of the Luofu's previous Sword Champion, though not known for his martial prowess.

skills.name: Glistening Light
skills.description: Jing Yuan deals Lightning DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of his ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Rifting Zenith
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Jing Yuan's ATK to all enemies and increases Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action by **2[i]** for the next turn.

skills.name: Lightbringer
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Jing Yuan's ATK to all enemies and increases Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action by **2[i]** for the next turn.

skills.name: Prana Extirpated
skills.description:
Summons "Lightning-Lord" at the start of the battle. "Lightning-Lord" has **1[i]** base SPD and **4[i]** base Hits Per Action. When the Lightning-Lord takes action, its hits are considered as **Follow-Up ATKs**, with each hit dealing Lightning DMG equal to ****2[i]%**** of Jing Yuan's ATK to a random single enemy, and enemies adjacent to it also receive Lightning DMG equal to **5[i]%** of the DMG dealt to the primary target enemy.
The Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action can reach a max of **6[i]**. Every time "Lightning-Lord's" Hits Per Action increases by 1, its SPD increases by **3[i]**. After the "Lightning-Lord's" action ends, its SPD and Hits Per Action return to their base values.
When Jing Yuan is **knocked down**, the "Lightning-Lord" will disappear.
When Jing Yuan is affected by **Crowd Control debuff**, the "Lightning-Lord" is unable to take action.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Spiritus Invocation
skills.description: After the Technique is used, the Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action in the first turn increases by **1[i]** at the start of the next battle.

ranks.name: Slash, Seas Split
ranks.description: When Lightning-Lord attacks, the DMG multiplier on enemies adjacent to the target enemy increases by an extra amount equal to **1[i]%** of the DMG multiplier against the primary target enemy.

ranks.name: Swing, Skies Squashed
ranks.description: After Lightning-Lord takes action, DMG dealt by Jing Yuan's Basic ATK, Skill, and Ultimate increases by **1[i]%**, lasting for **2[i]** turn(s).

ranks.name: Strike, Suns Subdued
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Spin, Stars Sieged
ranks.description: For each hit performed by the Lightning-Lord when it takes action, Jing Yuan regenerates **1[i]** Energy.

ranks.name: Stride, Spoils Seized
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: Sweep, Souls Slain
ranks.description:
Each hit performed by the Lightning-Lord when it takes action will make the target enemy Vulnerable.
While Vulnerable, enemies receive **1[i]%** more DMG until the end of the Lightning-Lord's current turn, stacking up to **2[i]** time(s).

1205.name: Blade
1205.description:
A member of the Stellaron Hunters, and a swordsman who abandoned his body to become a blade.
Pledges loyalty to "Destiny's Slave," and possesses a terrifying self-healing ability.

skills.name: Shard Sword
skills.description: Deals ****1[i]%**** of Blade's ATK as Wind DMG to a target enemy.

skills.name: Hellscape
skills.description:
Consumes HP equal to **1[i]%** of Blade's Max HP to enter the Hellscape state.
When Hellscape is active, his Skill cannot be used, his DMG dealt increases by ****4[i]%****, and his Basic ATK Shard Sword is enhanced to Forest of Swords for **2[i]** turn(s).
If Blade's current HP is insufficient, his HP will be reduced to 1 when he uses his Skill.
This Skill does not regenerate Energy. Using this Skill does not end the current turn.

skills.name: Death Sentence
skills.description:
Sets Blade's current HP to **50%** of his Max HP and deals Wind DMG to one enemy equal to the sum of ****1[i]%**** of his ATK, ****2[i]%**** of his Max HP, and ****5[i]%**** of the tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle. At the same time, deals Wind DMG to adjacent targets equal to the sum of ****3[f1]%**** of his ATK, ****4[i]%**** of his Max HP, and ****6[i]%**** of the tally of his HP loss in the current battle.
The tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle is capped at **7[i]%** of his Max HP. This value will be reset and re-accumulated after his Ultimate has been used.

skills.name: Shuhu's Gift
skills.description:
When Blade sustains DMG or consumes his HP, he gains 1 stack of Charge, stacking up to 5 times. A max of 1 Charge stack can be gained every time he is attacked.
When Charge stack reaches maximum, immediately launches a **Follow-Up ATK** on all enemies, dealing Wind DMG equal to ****2[i]%**** of Blade's ATK plus ****4[i]%**** of his Max HP. At the same time, restores Blade's HP by **3[i]%** of his Max HP. After the Follow-Up ATK, all Charges are consumed.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Karma Wind
skills.description:
Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering combat, consumes **2[i]%** of Blade's Max HP while dealing Wind DMG equal to **1[i]%** of his Max HP to all enemies.
If Blade's current HP is insufficient, his HP will be reduced to 1 when this Technique is used.

skills.name: Forest of Swords
skills.description:
Consumes HP equal to **1[i]%** of Blade's Max HP and deals Wind DMG equal to the sum of ****2[i]%**** of his ATK and ****4[i]%**** of his Max HP to one designated enemy. In addition, deals Wind DMG equal to the sum of ****3[i]%**** of Blade's ATK and ****5[i]%**** of his Max HP to adjacent targets.
If Blade's current HP is insufficient, his HP will be reduced to 1 when using "Forest of Swords."
"Forest of Swords" cannot regenerate Skill Points.

ranks.name: Blade Cuts the Deepest in Hell
ranks.description:
Blade's Ultimate deals additionally increased DMG to one designated enemy target, with the increased amount equal to **1[i]%** of the tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle.
The tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle is capped at **2[i]%** of his Max HP. The tally value will be reset and re-accumulated after his Ultimate has been used.

ranks.name: Ten Thousand Sorrows From One Broken Dream
ranks.description: When Blade is in the Hellscape state, his CRIT Rate increases by **1[i]%**.

ranks.name: Hardened Blade Bleeds Coldest Shade
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: Rejected by Death, Infected With Life
ranks.description: When Blade's current HP percentage drops to **50%** or lower of his Max HP, increases his Max HP by **1[i]%**. Stacks up to **2[i]** time(s).

ranks.name: Death By Ten Lords' Gaze
ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Reborn Into an Empty Husk
ranks.description: The maximum number of Charge stacks is reduced to 4. The **Follow-Up ATK** triggered by Talent deals additionally increased DMG, with the increased amount equal to **1[i]%** of Blade's Max HP.

1206.name: Sushang
1206.description:
Born on the Xianzhou Yaoqing, sent to the Cloud Knights of the Luofu for military training.
She wields her family sword, a gift from her mother, and longs for the future she will go on to write.

skills.name: Cloudfencer Art: Starshine
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Sushang's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Cloudfencer Art: Mountainfall
skills.description:
Deals Physical DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Sushang's ATK to one designated enemy. In addition, there is a **3[i]%** chance to trigger "Sword Stance" on the final hit, dealing Physical **Additional DMG** equal to ****2[i]%**** of Sushang's ATK to the enemy.
If the enemy is inflicted with **Weakness Break**, "Sword Stance" is guaranteed to trigger.

skills.name: Shape of Taixu: Dawn Herald
skills.description:
Deals Physical DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Sushang's ATK to one designated enemy target, and she immediately takes action. In addition, Sushang's ATK increases by ****4[i]%**** and using her Skill has 2 extra chances to trigger "Sword Stance" for **2[i]** turn(s).
